EXP-A-STATE.detail: 70% match with machine regime, but machine is noisy hourly data. Not the right test for Aporia.

EXP-B-TREND-PERSISTENCE.detail: When Aporia says UP, 7d return = +7.71% vs baseline +0.39%. n=7, too small for conclusions.

EXP-C-TRANSITION.detail: Aporia said RANGE on Aug 6 (machine transitioning to RANGE Aug 6-7). Said UP on Aug 19 (machine transitioning UP Aug 17-19). Appears to lead transitions by 0-2 days.

EXP-D-DOWNSTREAM-PNL.detail: Aporia gated strategy captured 22.13% of 24.89% August move by being deployed only 12/31 days. Value is activation timing.

verdict: PROMISING — need September data (n>30 per regime). Old directional label REJECTED.
key_insight: Aporia's value is not directional calls. It is REGIME INTERPRETATION that determines which strategies should be active. He correctly identified RANGE (Aug 6) and UP (Aug 19-28). His value is ACTIVATION TIMING, not raw direction.
falsification_status: NOT FALSIFIED — but n=7 is too small. Need n>30.
next_action: Fetch September data, increase n, re-run experiments
